provenance: Three supplemental Frame 27 rating records, carried from the supplemental review documents in the Drive source and reported as independently checked against it (2026-10-12). The Drive source was not reachable from the build machine, so these values were not re-opened during this change. Rater identities are withheld; records are referenced only by slot.
slot_mapping: Disclosed constant-strictness assumption: the three supplemental records are mapped onto the original rater slots r1, r2 and r4 by position. This is a slot mapping, not an identity claim.
missing_policy: No value in this file is imputed. A null means the rating is absent in the source.
